name: e2a Hosted Free
free_limit: 3,000 outbound emails/month (20 sends/day), 3 agents, 3 custom domains and 1 GiB storage on the hosted Free plan; agent inboxes and WebSocket delivery included.
watch_out: Free sending is capped at 20/day unless an add-on lifts it; outgoing email carries a 'Created with e2a' footer. Domain setup and SPF/DKIM are needed for custom-domain delivery. A paid Starter plan is separate. Payment-card and commercial-use terms for hosted Free are not explicitly confirmed.
